items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I knew Don as a kid... I didn't know that I was going to run into Don until years later... Sid Catlett picked up Don Lamond... He walked in the room and there was Sid Catlett and me.

ctx.x: Lester left the band and Don Byas came in.
'42, yes, around about 42-ish, because Don made that memorial thing, 'Harvard Blues.' We did that at the Leiderkranz Hall.
Buck was there, he could have been.
